Comment: Global system-FEX config. ROCKNIX's game-tuned FEX profile, adopted after the host GPU thunks (Vulkan/GL/EGL/drm) were HW-proven to SIGSEGV native x86-64 Linux games under system-FEX (Super Meat Boy + Garage Circuit Rally, 2026-07-11). Going THUNKLESS (ThunksDB all 0 -> the guest ArchLinux.ero x86 Mesa renders) plus ROCKNIX's JIT tuning (Multiblock/SMCChecks/MonoHacks/VolatileMetadata/DynamicL1Cache/DisableL2Cache/MaxInst) made both games run. Trade-off: no host-Turnip forwarding for native x86 Linux titles (guest GPU driver runs emulated); ROCKNIX ships this globally incl. 3D, and both our test titles are playable. RootFS is our 'ArchLinux.ero' (ROCKNIX uses 'ArchLinux'). NOTE: thunkless disables the WaylandClient thunk, so games use the guest's real libwayland (which already exports wl_list_*) -- this is why the FEX wl_list guest-thunk patch was dropped as moot. Windows games are unaffected (they run on Proton's bundled WoW64 FEX, not this config).
